basic_details.job_title: ICMR NIRWoH Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICMR National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (ICMR NIRWoH) has notified 1 vacancy for the Project Technical Support – I (Lab Technician) post on a purely temporary basis for a duration of one year. The engagement is temporary through an outsourcing agency with a pay of Rs. 23,400 per month. Eligible candidates holding a 10th plus Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT/DMLT) with two years experience or a three-year Graduate Degree in a relevant subject/field with one year of experience can apply. content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRWoH Project Technical Support I (Lab Technician) at a Glance

rows.details: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (ICMR-NIRWoH)

Prospective evaluation of etiological factors, trajectory of co morbidities and, efficacy and safety of various therapeutic agents among Indian women with Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS): A Multicentric ICMR-PCOS Cohort Study Phase II
ICMR-NIRWoH, J.M. Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012, Maharashtra

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements prescribed for the post before applying. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for physical interaction or online interview.

rows.essential_qualification: 10th + Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT/DMLT) with two years’ experience in the relevant subject/field OR Three-year Graduate Degree in a relevant subject/field with one year of experience in the relevant subject/field.
rows.desirable: B.Sc. in Medical Laboratory Technology / Medical Laboratory Science or equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is Rs. 23,400 per month, which includes Rs. 18,000 plus 30% HRA. The post is to be filled on a purely temporary basis through an outsourcing agency for a duration of one year under the ICMR-funded PCOS Cohort Study Phase II.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR NIRWoH Project Technical Support I (Lab Technician)
content_sections.text: Access the online application portal through the official link: Online Application Link . Select the post titled ‘Project Technical Support I (Lab Tech)’ to apply for the position. Fill out the online application form with the required details on or before 17 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a physical interaction or online interview. Candidates will be informed regarding the details of the interview later.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is filled on a purely temporary basis through an outsourcing agency for a duration of one year.

faq.question: Q2. Does the salary include house rent allowance?
faq.answer: Yes, the consolidated salary of Rs. 23,400 per month is inclusive of Rs. 18,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit to apply for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the post?
faq.answer: All applications will undergo screening, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for a physical interaction or online interview.
